summary.text: Ben Barnes is a Democratic member of the Maryland House of Delegates from District 21, where he has served since January 10, 2007, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. He is an attorney.

paragraphs.text: Barnes earned a bachelor's degree from the University of North Carolina, Greensboro in 1998 and a law degree from the University of Baltimore School of Law in 2003.

His professional experience includes working as an attorney with the Law Offices of Donna L. Crary, clerking for Judge James J. Lombardi of the Prince George's County Circuit Court, and serving as a legislative aide to the Maryland State Senate President.

For 2025-2026, Ballotpedia lists Barnes as chair of the Appropriations Committee, and his other assignments as the Legislative Policy Committee, the Joint Federal Action Oversight Committee, and the Rules & Executive Nominations Committee.
